title: 25 years after 9/11, the U.S. starts rolling back travel restrictions, from liquids to gate access
summary: In a significant shift, the U.S. government is beginning to relax certain travel restrictions that were implemented in the aftermath of the 9/11 attacks. This decision reflects the evolving nature of threats and advancements in technology that have changed the landscape of air travel security. As the anniversary of the attacks approaches, these changes could signal a new era in how security measures are approached at airports across the nation.
